mapper.select: select * from book_category order by sort
SELECT b.*, c.name AS category_name FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (isbn, name, author, publisher, publish_date, category_id, price, total_num, available_num, cover_url, intro, status) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{name}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{publishDate}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{totalNum}, #{totalNum}, #{coverUrl}, #{intro}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET isbn = #{dto.isbn}, name = #{dto.name}, author = #{dto.author}, publisher = #{dto.publisher}, publish_date = #{dto.publishDate}, category_id = #{dto.categoryId}, price = #{dto.price}, total_num = #{dto.totalNum}, available_num = #{availableNum}, cover_url = #{dto.coverUrl}, intro = #{dto.intro}, status = #{dto.status} WHERE id = #{id}
